business.name: Nonna Delia's
business.description: Nonna Delia's is a pizza restaurant in Flushing, NY.

reviews.author: Simone Hanlen
reviews.text:
I ran into this pizzeria in College Point and WOW! They have a slice counter, restaurant, and bar. The atmosphere was cozy, and decorated with foliage.
The service was super attentive and we got suggestions for pizza. Would definitely visit again!

reviews.author: Madison DeSoto
reviews.text: My friends and I came here for lunch and everything about our experience was stellar! The food was delicious, the staff was incredibly friendly, and the vibes were fantastic! The chicken Alfredo and fried ravioli are amazing! After we finished eating the manager brought us some delicious cinnamon sugar fried dough and we ordered a tiramisu and coffee which were just lovely! I can’t stress enough how kind and accommodating the manager was. We will definitely be going back.

reviews.author: Irene Minard
reviews.text: I was visiting from Chicago and I wanted a great pizza 🍕and omggg can I say what a great amazing pizza! Service was awesome! When I come back to N.Y I will get another pizza from   Nonnas Delia’s wow thank you

reviews.author: Joel Monserrate
reviews.text: A most excellent pizzeria restaurant excellent service excellent food and plenty of variety. Did you know they have cinnamon zeppoles?Awesome!

We're open Mon–Thu 10 AM to 9:30 PM; Fri–Sat 10 AM to 10:30 PM; Sun 10 AM to 9:30 PM.

faq.a: Start with our signature dishes: the Upside Down Sicilian Pizza ($26.95), the Cauliflower Gluten Free Pizza ($16.95), the Sicilian Cheese Pizza ($26.95), the Large Hawaiian Pizza ($29.95), the Large Buffalo Chicken Pizza ($28.95) and the Mini Gluten Free Pizza ($16.95).

business.ownerWords:
Nonna Delia's is a pizza restaurant at 18-32 College Point Blvd in Queens, in Flushing, NY. Look for us in College Point, beside Dunkin' and College Point Optometric Associates, near Fisherman Depot and City Fresh Market. We're open for lunch and dinner, seven days a week.

The heart of the menu is the gourmet pizza section: 12 choices, from the Nonna Famous Grandma Sicilian Pizza to the Nonna Famous Sicilian Alla Vodka Pizza. There's also a pizza list with seven choices. For guests who avoid gluten, the menu has the Mini Gluten Free Pizza and the Cauliflower Gluten Free Pizza.

Guests rate Nonna Delia's 4.2 stars across 464+ Google reviews. “The food was delicious, the staff was incredibly friendly, and the vibes were fantastic!” (Madison DeSoto, Google review) “I was visiting from Chicago and I wanted a great pizza 🍕and omggg can I say what a great amazing pizza!” (Irene Minard, Google review)

You can eat in, take out or order delivery. You can order ahead online and pick it up at the restaurant. There's free street parking and paid street parking. Stop by 18-32 College Point Blvd, or call (718) 445-6662 and we'll have your order ready. We cater parties of all sizes, from office meetings to family gatherings and special events. Build the spread around pizza, pasta, salads, trays, and Italian comfort food.
